mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory ( drug_id, batch_no, expiry_date, quantity, locked_quantity, location_code, created_by, updated_by, deleted ) VALUES ( #{drugId}, #{batchNo}, #{expiryDate}, #{quantity}, #{lockedQuantity}, #{locationCode}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{deleted} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, drug_id, batch_no, expiry_date, quantity, locked_quantity, location_code, created_by, updated_by, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM inventory WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, drug_id, batch_no, expiry_date, quantity, locked_quantity, location_code, created_by, updated_by, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM inventory WHERE drug_id = #{drugId} AND batch_no = #{batchNo} AND expiry_date = #{expiryDate} AND deleted = 0

SELECT i.id, i.drug_id, d.drug_code, d.drug_name, i.batch_no, i.expiry_date, i.quantity, i.locked_quantity, i.location_code, i.created_at, i.updated_at FROM inventory i INNER JOIN drug d ON d.id = i.drug_id WHERE i.id = #{id} AND i.deleted = 0 AND d.deleted = 0
